22.  (1)  Every  Hydrographic  Surveyor  or  a  Nautical
Cartographer, as the case may be, who is registered under
section 18, shall have the right to use if such person is –
(a)  a  Hydrographic  Surveyor,  the  abbreviated
designation “HyS”; and
(b)  a  Nautical  Cartographer,  the  abbreviated
designation “NauC”.
(2) A  person  shall  not  use  any  abbreviated  designation
referred to in subsection (1) unless such person is registered
as a Hydrographic Surveyor or a Nautical Cartographer under
the provisions of this Act.
